overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: posting minutes online is not required, and the Commission has not yet missed the timely-approval deadline because it has held no meetings since January 14, 2020.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission failed to post minutes of its January 14 and March 10, 2020 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, a failure to post meeting minutes to a website does not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Construed as an allegation that the Commission failed to timely review and approve minutes of its January 14, 2020 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Commission has not held three meetings since January 14, 2020, approval of minutes from that meeting is not yet untimely.
